prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: CLEAN STATIC SCENE PLATE for an existing Unity 2D watercolor game level.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose inspiration. Preserve EXACT original framing, proportions, pixel-aligned geometry and watercolor treatment. Same approximately 1859x846 landscape aspect. This is asset separation for compositing; all removed elements will later be drawn dynamically by the engine.

REMOVE ONLY the following dynamic objects and effects, painting the correctly matching static surface/background behind each:
1. ALL golden light beams: the diagonal sunlight stripe at upper left, the long horizontal beam, and the diagonal ray at right. Remove their bright source/contact points, glows and ray-shaped baked highlights. Natural warm ambient garden sunlight remains.
2. The single little glowing spirit on the right bank, including its halo and foot contact glow.
3. The large diagonally upright green guide-leaf blade near the middle. Remove only the leaf blade and its leaf veins; retain the small brown/gold lower-left hinge and fixed curved root chute.
4. The separate hanging green/yellow leaf shutter in front of the central vertical root screen. Reveal the dark root screen underneath. Retain the small rectangular horizontal aperture through the roots around x1160,y468, but make its inside dark and unlit.
5. The brown seedpod in the middle-island cup. Empty the cup completely. Remove the low movable horizontal treadle board to its right, replacing it with the natural island ground. The cup and the nearby lever handle/base may remain stationary.
6. The silver reflective panels of BOTH mirror props. Keep their brown wooden/root supports and round pivots, but remove the silver panels themselves, revealing soft back wall or vegetation behind them. No residual silver shard.
7. ALL thin mechanical ropes looping over the two upper pulley wheels and hanging downward to the mechanisms. KEEP both actual round wooden pulley wheels. Do not remove the massive natural living tree roots.

KEEP EVERYTHING ELSE EXACTLY:
The three large banks and their ledge top surfaces; BOTH broad water gaps; all THREE small bare jumping ledges in their current precise positions and their root brackets; the long EMPTY upper seed trough/operating shelf; the curved fixed root chute and lower hinge; central dense vertical root barrier from canopy into the water and its aperture; visible end handle; two mirror root bases; both pulley wheels; outer garden canopy; soft pale brick wall and ivy; all shore plants and foreground roots; exit pipe.
The huge exposed beast belly at right stays pale ivory with the single dark-gray target scale, but the target scale must be UNLIT with no bright point or emission.
Retain the water surface, soft ripples and natural diffuse reflections, but no sharp gold reflection painted specifically for the removed ray.
Do NOT alter the background lightening/contrast level, palette, camera, platforms, their sizes or positions. Do not add, move or enlarge any props. No characters, glowing motes, labels, text, UI or diagram marks. One full opaque landscape clean plate, no transparency.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: TRANSPARENT PNG GAME PROP ATLAS extracted/redrawn faithfully from the reference watercolor level.
Input image 1 supplies the EXACT existing prop style and shapes. Isolate the following SIX objects as six separate non-overlapping sprites on a genuinely transparent alpha canvas. NO scene, NO backdrop, NO text, NO labels, NO ground shadows, NO boxes or grid lines. Preserve hand-painted watercolor paper grain within opaque object pixels, delicate brown line art and subtle warm ivory edge accents.

Canvas: portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, ideally 1024x1536, arranged in exactly TWO columns and THREE rows, equal square cells. Keep each object entirely inside its cell with a generous transparent margin (at least 60 pixels in each 512px cell). Transparent space must separate all objects. Objects should be centered within their own cells, not touch one another.

SIX CELL CONTENTS, in reading order:
TOP LEFT (row1 col1): the broad green GUIDE LEAF blade from the middle of the reference. Alone, without fixed curved root chute, without circular metal hinge and without stalk extending to the floor. A diagonally upright pointed veined leaf, tapering to its attachment at lower LEFT and its tip upper RIGHT, matching the source green leaf. The small stem/attachment point at its lower-left end is the rotation pivot. Retain raised curled leaf edges which make it a usable ramp.
TOP RIGHT (row1 col2): the HANGING LEAF SHUTTER from the central tree. Alone, without rope, knot, branch or surrounding tree. Vertical leaf hood, upper attachment tip, green panels with golden yellow underside, slightly flared/scalloped bottom. Match source silhouette. Top tip is the hanging pivot.
MIDDLE LEFT (row2 col1): ONE spherical brown ribbed SEEDPOD alone. No cup, no leaf, no string, no shadow. Rounded nearly circular outline, brown woody segments and thin lighter ridges, slightly irregular botanical shape; fits within a square.
MIDDLE RIGHT (row2 col2): ONE MIRROR PANEL alone. No roots, no stand, no pivot mechanism. A slim silver reflective shard with a fine warm brass/brown rim, vertically upright as a standalone object in its neutral position. Slightly irregular pointed top and bottom, long-to-wide ratio about 2:1. Only subtle watercolor silver/cream reflections, NO glowing streak or emission. Center is its rotation pivot.
BOTTOM LEFT (row3 col1): ONE low horizontal PRESSURE TREADLE BOARD alone. A flat narrow leaf-and-wood strip with a thin outlined profile, warm moss-green top and brown wooden edge. No seed, no cup, no handle, no rope, no ground and no big support frame. Long horizontal aspect about 5:1. Looks like the low board beneath the seed assembly in the reference, suitable for slight downward rotation. Right end is pivot.
BOTTOM RIGHT (row3 col2): ONE DARK FEEDING SCALE alone, matching the charcoal-gray pointed organic leaf-shaped scale on the pale beast belly. No surrounding ivory scales, no creature body, no light ray, no glow. Angled lower-left to upper-right, softly faceted watercolor scale texture with a thin brown contour. Center is the pivot.

DO NOT include any other props, platforms, plants, sparkles, ropes or characters. NO decorative sheet border. No checkerboard pattern painted into the image. Background must be truly transparent; all objects have clean alpha edges, with no opaque haze or large outer glow.
